# Reporting Security Vulnerabilities
If you discover a security vulnerability in DCL, there are two options for reporting  the vulnerability to the DCL Security Team.
  - **Option 1 _(preferred)_**  : [Report the vulnerability at this link](https://github.com/DCL/DCL/security/advisories/new). See [Privately reporting a security vulnerability](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability#privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) for instruction on doing this.
  - **Option 2**: Report the vulnerability by sending an email to the DCL Security Team email at security@dcl.org . If possible, please encrypt your email via PGP with this [public key](https://www.dcl.org/files/DCL-security-pgp-key.asc).
